scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Uniform Permanence in Weakly Reversible Mass-Action Systems” (preprints/Uniform-Permanence-in-Weakly-Reversible-Mass-Action-Systems-October-5-2026/permanence.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 149 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 69edba6a8946a551), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let C ⊂ Zd ≥0 be finite, let R ⊂ C × C be weakly reversible, and fix positive rate constants in (1.1). For every positive stoichiometric class P there is a nonempty compact convex set KP ⊂ P with the following properties. Every initial point x0 ∈ P gives a unique global positive solution, and there is a finite T(x0) ≥ 0 such that x(t) ∈ KP (t ≥ T(x0 )). Moreover, KP is forward invariant. In particular, there is εP ∈ (0, 1), depending only on the network, the fixed rates, and P, such that every such solution satisfies εP ≤ xi(t) ≤ ε−1 P (1 ≤ i ≤ d, t ≥ T(x0 )). (1.2)
